verdict.rationale: Viam documents data capture, SQL/MQL querying, ML model training, and vision services. These are building blocks a user could use to build analysis, not a built-in feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The Discovery service suggests component configurations from detected hardware, which is an adjacent feature and not data insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
